messages.subject: release of seewave 1.7.2
messages.body_plain:
Dear seewave users,

A new version of seewave (1.7.2) is on CRAN now.

This version should comply with the recent update of tuneR (1.0).

Thanks to Jesse Ross for the patch regarding multi-channels wav files.

Enjoy,

Jerome
